spec.name: M6.Cyclic.signature_divides
spec.statement: ∀ a b M : M6.Cyclic.BinaryPolynomial, M6.Cyclic.signature a b M ∣ a ∧ M6.Cyclic.signature a b M ∣ b ∧ M6.Cyclic.signature a b M ∣ M
spec.guidance: Use EuclideanDomain.gcd_dvd_left/right explicitly qualified and transitivity. Return tactic lines only without leading by.

spec.name: M6.Cyclic.signature_bezout
spec.statement: ∀ a b M : M6.Cyclic.BinaryPolynomial, ∃ p q r : M6.Cyclic.BinaryPolynomial, M6.Cyclic.signature a b M = p*a + q*b + r*M
spec.guidance: Expand twice EuclideanDomain.gcd_eq_gcd_ab; choose products of gcdA/gcdB then ring. Return tactic lines only without leading by.

spec.name: M6.Cyclic.kernel_divisibility
spec.statement: ∀ a b M h : M6.Cyclic.BinaryPolynomial, (M ∣ a*h ∧ M ∣ b*h) ↔ M ∣ M6.Cyclic.signature a b M * h
spec.guidance: Forward use accepted Bezout and divisibility sums, reverse signature divides a,b. Return tactic lines only without leading by.

spec.name: M6.Cyclic.kernel_cancellation
spec.statement: ∀ F K h : M6.Cyclic.BinaryPolynomial, F ≠ 0 → (F*K ∣ F*h ↔ K ∣ h)
spec.guidance: Use mul_dvd_mul_iff_left or explicit divisibility witnesses and cancellation. Return tactic lines only without leading by.

spec.name: M6.Cyclic.boundary_is_cycle
spec.statement: ∀ (N : ℕ) (a b : M6.Cyclic.BinaryPolynomial) (h : M6.Cyclic.CycleRing N), M6.Cyclic.syndrome N a b (M6.Cyclic.boundary N a b h) = 0
spec.guidance: Unfold, commutativity gives two identical terms; characteristic two gives zero. Return tactic lines only without leading by.

spec.name: M6.Cyclic.boundary_kernel
spec.statement: ∀ (N : ℕ) (a b h : M6.Cyclic.BinaryPolynomial), M6.Cyclic.boundary N a b (M6.Cyclic.image N h) = (0,0) ↔ M6.Cyclic.modulus N ∣ M6.Cyclic.signature a b (M6.Cyclic.modulus N) * h
spec.guidance: Use AdjoinRoot.mk_eq_zero iff divisibility, map_mul and Prod.mk.injEq then kernel_divisibility. Return tactic lines only without leading by.
